summary_alerts.html:
CONSENSUS BUY — META (Fields D + McCaul R + Khanna D, cross-party)
Three members across both parties accumulated Meta, anchored by Fields' ~$175K position; combined disclosed value ~$274K.

CONSENSUS BUY — PEAK (McCaul R + Khanna D, cross-party)
McCaul placed a single ~$175K buy in Healthpeak; Khanna added a smaller position.

CONSENSUS BUY — NFLX (Fields D + McCaul R, cross-party)
Fields ~$75K, McCaul layered in four separate buys.

CONSENSUS SELL — INTU (Khanna D + McCaul R + Gottheimer D, cross-party)
Three-member, two-party exit from Intuit — the cleanest bearish signal in the dataset.

CONSENSUS SELL — UBER, HUM, AMZN, GOOGL, CVS, WDAY (cross-party)
A consistent rotation out of mega-cap consumer/tech and managed-care names, led by McCaul and Khanna in tandem.

CONVICTION — McCormick GS ~$1.23M (7 buys)
Senator McCormick — former Goldman Sachs CEO — added to GS seven times for ~$1.23M while also disclosing ~$3M in financials sales. Highest single-name conviction in the file.

MIXED SIGNAL — MSFT, GOOGL, WDAY, UNH, V
Same names appear on both buy and sell sides across different members; treat as conflicted rather than directional.
